title: RES-D4 HD-3 Audit-Coverage Substrate Stub (Tag-72)
description: Audit-only fixture catalogue for the HD-3 Audit-Coverage substrate-preparation work. This file enumerates the audit-sample-priority-tag inventory, the schema-extension audit-probe shape, and the rollback/forward-compat documentation choices that the Tag-72 substrate-prep work is allowed to inspect, document, and probe-test in fixture mode. It MUST NOT be interpreted as a Henrik-Voss audit-sample-config amendment: every audit-priority marker carries 'kind: fixture', the probe defaults to inspection-only, and no audit-sample-config rotation entry is emitted. See docs/operations/res-d4-high-residual-mitigation-deep-dive.md §3.3 / §6.4 / §7 / §8.

strict_audit_coverage_invariant.schema_extension_rule: registry-pointer-record key-shape MUST be a strict superset of route_registry_nats_kv_backend.py discovery key-shape

audit_priority_tags.purpose: Pin the canonical priority value RES-D4 carries in the Tag-72 audit-coverage catalogue. The verifier-acceptance branch reads this tag exclusively in inspection mode; no audit-sample-config rotation entry is emitted from this stub.

Default priority value carried by every non-RES-D4 sample entry in the Tag-72 catalogue. Exists to demonstrate that the priority field is a discriminator (not a flag) and that flipping the discriminator requires HR/Audit-hand, not Reza-hand.

Negative-control entry: a probe asked to flip the audit-sample priority value from Reza-hand MUST reject with an 'audit-priority-owner-mismatch' diagnostic. This entry pins the Tag-67 §5.1 B5 failure-mode mitigation under hand-boundary discipline.

schema_extension_audit_probes.name: schema-extension-probe--strict-superset-ok
schema_extension_audit_probes.purpose: Validate the probe-side audit shape when the proposed registry-pointer-record key-shape is a strict superset of the existing route_registry_nats_kv_backend.py discovery key-shape. The probe accepts this configuration in inspection-only mode (Tag-67 §5.1 A4 mitigation).

schema_extension_audit_probes.name: schema-extension-probe--key-shape-collision
schema_extension_audit_probes.purpose: Validate the probe-side audit shape when the proposed registry-pointer-record key-shape collides with the existing discovery key-shape (e.g. reuses a key with incompatible value-type). The probe MUST reject with a 'schema-extension-collision' diagnostic per Tag-67 §5.1 A4.

schema_extension_audit_probes.name: schema-extension-probe--v1-consumer-break
schema_extension_audit_probes.purpose: Negative-control probe: v1→v2 migration where the v1-consumer compatibility smoke fails (a v1 consumer breaks against the v2 schema). The probe MUST reject with a 'v1-consumer-break' diagnostic per Tag-67 §5.1 A5.

rollback_audit_choices.purpose: Document the atomic-revert rollback choice: on rollback, the NATS-KV bucket extension is explicitly torn down (key-removal of registry-pointer-record entries). Honours Tag-65 §6.2 step-3 rollback hot-spot tightening.

Document the forward-compat rollback choice: on rollback, the NATS-KV bucket extension is left in place by design with an explicit forward-compat note. Honours Tag-67 §5.1 B4 mitigation (rollback-leaves-bucket is acceptable if documented).
Negative-control rollback choice: leaving the bucket extension in place without a forward-compat note is forbidden. The probe MUST reject with a 'rollback-undocumented' diagnostic per Tag-67 §5.1 B4.

verifier_acceptance_rules.rule: audit-only branch accepts audit-priority-tag inspection without rotation-entry emit
schema-extension probe accepts strict-superset, rejects collision and v1-consumer-break
rollback-choice probe accepts atomic-revert OR forward-compat-note, rejects silent-leave
audit-priority-owner is HR/Audit-hand, not Reza-hand (hand-boundary discipline)
